title: visual-shot: cut agent workflow latency
brief: Collapses the capture/diff/recap workflow from 5 processes and 4 Chromium launches to 2 and 2 for a UI PR, and from 3 launches to 1 for a text+visual recap. Adds the URL-capture options the recipes needed, plus a cross-process asset memo.

blocks.title: How this was measured
blocks.body: Warm cache, local pages, indicative wall time on this machine. Process and browser-launch counts are deterministic and come from the command modules; the SHA cost is the pinned 2.5 MB Mermaid asset. This artifact itself was rendered by the new one-run command: HTML + GFM + PNG in one invocation.

items.label: 152 tests pass, 0 fail (4 new files/areas covered)
`capture` batch + `diff` URL mode use one browser launch
`recap` emits HTML + GFM + filtered PNG in one run
Deferred: `term` pair mode (no clean flag shape) and pure-Node local diff (needs a PNG codec)
